historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Saudi Arabia's discovery of oil in 1938 and subsequent modernization efforts under King Faisal led to a significant shift in the country's economy and global influence. The nation's role in the 9/11 attacks and its current involvement in regional conflicts have also had far-reaching consequences.
